passages.question: What is the 2026 taxable wage base, and how are wages above it treated?
passages.excerpt: You only pay taxes for wages up to the taxable wage base. We consider anything more as excess wages. While you report excess wages, you do not pay taxes on them. Year | Taxable wage base: 2026 | $78,200; 2025 | $72,800 ...

passages.question: How is the employer's 2026 total tax rate made up, and for how long does it apply?
passages.excerpt: We send your tax rate each year in December. It applies to the entire next calendar year. ... Your total tax rate: experience tax rate + social tax rate + EAF. ... The fee ranges from 0.02% to .03%, depending on your rate class.
